rollback: revert this branch's commits: .github/workflows/ci.yml, Scripts/test-ios-layout.sh, Tests/iOSLayout/UITests/shards.json and the tests under Scripts/tests; no cache, secret, protection or external state changes. E4 alone: revert its commit and the DerivedData follow-up.

amendments.why: E1 was rejected by its rule (the shared build ran the same 186 and 116 SwiftCompile tasks). The baseline's logs then showed the layout shards idle through the Simulator's boot, shard 2 the longest job in 3 of 4 runs, and the package job the longest in the fourth. Three hypotheses replace E1; their rules were written after reading the baseline and before any candidate measurement of them, except that E2's local run (16 tests, 129 checkpoints, passed) had finished.

decision_rules.E2: keep building the layout fixture during the Simulator's boot if the whole suite passes locally with every checkpoint verified and the script still runs no test before the boot has finished or after a failed build; hosted, the shard's step must be shorter than its baseline by at least half the boot wait it used to spend (baseline 68 to 165 s), with no first-attempt failure in the journeys in at least 3 runs
decision_rules.E3: keep moving one journey from shard 2 to shard 1 if the plan still passes its partition check, both shards pass locally with their own counts, and on the four baseline runs' own journey times the larger shard's sum is smaller in the median
decision_rules.E4: keep the beta iOS build in layout shard 1 if the combining check still fails on every failed, cancelled, skipped or missing build outcome (tested by running its shell), and hosted, shard 1's output reaches the check; if the output does not arrive the check fails closed and E4 alone is reverted

cases_added: a shard-1 build outcome that never reaches the combining check fails it (negative, local)
the combining checks' shell under four mutations (negative, local)
